# testdata/disc — synthetic disc images for the disc-import tests (ADR-0066)

`synth-windwaker.gcm` is a **synthetic** GameCube image — not a real disc and
not a copy of any real game's data (AGENTS.md rule 5). It is generated by
`windwaker.SynthDiscImage("GZLE01", 4 fixed lines)` in
`internal/games/adapter/windwaker/synth.go`, and it is **deterministic**: the
BMP texture rows are derived from the text and the RARC node order is sorted,
so the committed bytes are stable.

Provenance is enforced by `TestSyntheticDiscFixture`
(`internal/games/adapter/windwaker/synth_fixture_test.go`), which fails if a
fresh synth differs from the committed file and re-parses the committed file
through the real `gcdisc.Open` + adapter `ParseDisc` path the import job uses.

SHA-256 of the committed fixture (the Playwright walk asserts this prefix in
the import report):

    86bca76f055db1b9d2b3ba5497ae71edaf21ca9064cda9d3129f27fcce57314b

Regenerate after a deliberate generator change:

```sh
GN_UPDATE_FIXTURE=1 go test ./internal/games/adapter/windwaker/ -run TestSyntheticDiscFixture
```

The Playwright disc-import walk (web/e2e, project `disc`) serves this directory
as `GAME_NARRATOR_IMPORT_DIR`.
